title: Request-weighted cost allocation
method: Synthetic month: direct costs $3,000 and $2,000 plus a $1,000 shared pool allocated 60/40 by request share. Totals reconcile to $6,000. The chosen driver is an assumption, not proof of fairness.
alt: Request-weighted cost allocation. Team A total: 3600 USD; Team B total: 2400 USD. Illustrative values.
